cookSays.line: 📖 Your hands remember: weave cloth (3 plant fiber — strip it from cleared brush), and build a Water Filter (cloth + charcoal from fire ashes). Dirty water doesn't have to stay dirty.

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Isaac Popov. Midwife. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dog tags, Spare Socks, Field suture kit, Mixtape, Coat button. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, something walked past the treeline on two legs. Too tall. It stopped. It listened. Then it kept going. Nobody slept after that.
A man, maybe 40s is at the cookpot, tasting off the spoon, frowning, adding a pinch of something. Better close to the fire today.
🍲 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is eating by the fire — not talking, just eating.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.

🔥 The fire settles. Valeria has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Speedbump — I put it down today." "It doesn't move. It hasn't moved in an hour. Its head is suddenly somewhere else." "It seals itself. The shell clicks shut — nearly invulnerable. Wait it out, or flip it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Rowan says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Dale breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Marcus has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Rut King — I put it down today." "He lowers the crown. Paws the earth once, twice. The whole forest holds its breath." "His chest swells. The inhale goes on too long — cover your ears or get behind something." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Fatima asks "And you're still standing." Rowan mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Rowan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Murkcap — I put it down today." "The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers." "The cap tilts. The stem creaks like a ship's mast. Get out from under it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Marcus mutters "And you're still standing." Natalia breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Alva has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Living Wire — I put it down today." "The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Dale mutters "We've been walking past those." Rowan breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Fatima has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Mountain Lord — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Natalia asks "Say that again — slower." Valeria says "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
⚔️ Fatima killed the Mountain Lord with their party — 3 rounds, 17 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.
Fatima looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.
You catch fragments by the fire — Rowan telling Diana about Natalia. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
Fatima came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
